reasons.plausibility: High-entropy stabilization via slowed diffusion and suppressed phase segregation aligns with known principles, though the exact interplay of elastic strain and entropy is not fully established.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison of annealed versus as-synthesized nanoparticles under service conditions with well-defined measurements can decisively confirm or refute the proposed stabilization mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a key open question by linking composition, processing, and stability in high-entropy nanoparticles, offering a practical experimental path to guide materials design.
